scope: ordinary K1 getup 73->22; simulation and bounded training preparation only
confirmed_fixes: Randomized reset q bounded by URDF before teleportation
Delayed hold targets bounded even if physical q crosses a solver limit
Geometry probe relocated above terrain; placement uses per-body local terrain clearance
Root/DOF caches, finite-difference history and reset policy inputs synchronized

residual_peak_example.interpretation: Another actor reset advances this actor without a DOF actuation submission for the 2 ms global probe. Contact/inertia/constraint behavior occurs with an in-range target. Per-joint causal decomposition of the contact force has not been measured.

retained_upstream_semantics: Every reset batch still advances the entire world by one extra 2 ms probe; report physical elapsed time separately from policy elapsed time. This should be removed in a separate, benchmarked kinematic-reset implementation before assuming exact 50 Hz at large environment counts.
Public pushes are submitted once per policy step, not every physics substep. The sustained-force test deliberately differs.

Intermediate-keyframe resets return gait_process=0 before the next policy update recalculates execution_time/total_time. Leave the public schedule unchanged in this patch; any correction needs a phase-contract ablation.
inactive_source_issue: The head-name lookup writes lower_body_indices instead of head_indices in upstream code. The only consumer is body_in_soles reward, which is commented out in the tested K1 YAML. Fix and validate this before enabling that optional reward.
training_next: Use the accepted local code and actor-only bootstrap for a bounded pilot, verify checkpoint/optimizer/RNG restoration and export, then define a duration/seed/scale budget for formal training. Do not treat the public actor or pilot checkpoints as an improved deployable policy.
